description:
Three gf2-core benchmark harnesses leave cells unmeasured: the $n = 512$ minimal-polynomial cell of `examples/bench_csv_emitter.rs`, the $\mathrm{GF}(2^{32})$ field of `benches/fieldmatrix_gemm.rs`, and the $n = 4096$ reference cell of `benches/fieldmatrix_ple.rs` for the operations outside the fast product.

## Background

The harness headers marked these cells as deferred; the source-comment sweep removed the statements, and this issue tracks them.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each cell is measured in the overnight benchmark window with a committed receipt, per `@/inv/benchmark-backed-performance`, or is removed from the harness's declared cell set with the reason recorded where the set is defined.
title: Measure or retire the deferred gf2-core benchmark cells
